customer_name: Shanghai Stock Exchange Technology Co., Ltd. (上交所技术公司)
business_problem: The securities industry needed a trusted, regulator-compliant way to exchange, store, transmit, and back up large volumes of sensitive financial data so institutions could move away from inefficient paper-based or fragmented digital workflows.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Shanghai Stock Exchange Technology built the Zhengtong Data Exchange and Storage Platform as a shared industry service for securities, funds, banks, trusts, and insurers. The platform unifies data exchange, storage, backup, and enterprise cloud-disk capabilities under a financial-grade architecture designed to meet high security and regulatory requirements, including two-site three-center resilience expectations. Institutions can send and receive files or datasets through graphical and API-driven workflows, use point-to-point or one-to-many encrypted transfer, and store large files on infrastructure that automatically backs up data and applies protections such as per-file keys and cloud antivirus. The platform is also designed to connect regulators, service providers, and financial institutions on the same trusted network so document submission, data distribution, and cross-institution collaboration can be handled more efficiently than legacy paper or ad hoc digital channels.
products_used: Zhengtong Data Exchange and Storage Platform

solution_components.name: Zhengtong Data Exchange and Storage Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the shared financial-industry backbone for regulated data exchange, storage, and backup workflows.

solution_components.name: Financial Data Exchange Service
solution_components.role: Supports graphical and API-based file and dataset transfer across institutions and regulators.

solution_components.name: Financial Enterprise Cloud Disk Service
solution_components.role: Provides secure cloud storage and backup for institutions that lack their own compliant infrastructure.

solution_components.name: Encrypted Data and File Transmission
solution_components.role: Protects transfers with per-file keys and encrypted routing across point-to-point and one-to-many exchange patterns.

data_flow: Financial documents and datasets move from institutions, regulators, and data-service providers into the Zhengtong platform, where encrypted transfer services route them through graphical or API workflows. Data is then stored, backed up, or synchronized through the platform's storage and cloud-disk services so downstream institutions can retrieve the right files through a trusted compliant exchange channel.
business_outcome: Shanghai Stock Exchange Technology created a higher-trust financial-data service layer that improves submission and exchange efficiency, broadens compliant storage access for smaller institutions, and strengthens operational continuity for the industry.
metrics: The platform has connected more than 300 financial institutions.
architecture_clues: The platform supports both graphical and API-driven exchange modes for institutions with different operating models.
Per-file keys, automatic backup, cloud antivirus, and two-site three-center architecture are all part of the design.
The service is meant to connect regulators, exchanges, service providers, and market institutions on one trusted network.
evidence_quotes: Baidu and Shanghai Stock Exchange Technology jointly built the Zhengtong platform to open a secure path from regulators and service institutions to financial institutions (original: 联合上交所技术共同打造证通数据交换存储平台，打通数据从监管机构、服务机构到各类金融机构的数据分发、服务到安全的通路).
The platform serves more than 300 institutions across securities, trusts, funds, banks, and insurance (original: 证通数据交换平台已接入超过300家的行业机构客户，包括证券、信托、基金、银行、保险等金融类别).
It supports data exchange, storage and backup, and enterprise cloud-disk services with multiple client and transmission modes (original: 平台提供多样的数据交换和存储服务，包含金融数据服务、数据和文件交换、数据存储和备份、金融企业云盘服务).
Every file has its own key, data can be backed up automatically, and cloud antivirus is supported (original: 在此平台上，每一份文件都有自己的密钥，数据端可以自动备份，还支持云端杀毒).
